reason: B proposes a physically credible active-metal interlayer: Ti can improve W/Cu wetting and adhesion and reduce interfacial porosity, with direct microscopy and thermal-conductivity comparisons providing a clear falsification route. A relies on poorly supported claims that Cu-coated graphene enhances W/Cu wetting and diffusion at 1280 °C and asserts an unexplained 20–25% gain, while graphene may instead add thermal boundary resistance or react at the interface.
